title: Delivery Gate Manifest
description: Machine-readable change manifest for Accelerated Delivery Gate. Defines the exact scope, safety constraints, and authorization boundaries for a single change unit.

change_id.description: Unique identifier for this change unit (e.g. 'p2-provider-docs-2026-08').

title.description: Human-readable short title for this change.

base_branch.description: Required branch for this change. Default: 'main'.

expected_base_commit.description: Expected SHA of HEAD before staging. If set, delivery gate will reject any other base commit (CAS precondition). Leave empty to skip base commit check.

expected_remote_base.description: Expected SHA of origin/main before push. Defaults to expected_base_commit when not set. Used by dg publish to verify remote has not advanced since the local commit was created.

allowed_paths.description: Exact list of files allowed to be changed (modified or added). Must be an exhaustive enumeration — no implicit additions. Empty array means no changes allowed.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths that must NOT appear in the changeset. Takes priority over allowed_paths.

expected_file_count.description: Expected number of changed files. Must equal length of allowed_paths. Enforced as exact equality check.

allow_modify.description: Allow modification of tracked files. Default: true.

allow_delete.description: Allow deletion of tracked files. Default: false. Deletion requires explicit opt-in.

allow_rename.description: Allow renaming of tracked files. Default: false. Rename requires explicit opt-in.

commit_subject.description: Exact commit subject line. Must be single-line, non-empty. No body or trailers will be added. Forbidden prefixes: Co-authored-by, Signed-off-by, Reviewed-by, Change-Id.

version_assignment.description: Version to assign for this change. 'none' = versionless governance commit (no tag created).

tag_policy.description: Tag policy. 'none' = no tag created. Tagging requires separate explicit authorization.

push_policy.description: Push policy. 'main_only' = git push origin main only, no force, no tags.

quality_required.description: Whether to run the Quality Pipeline gate. Default: true.

catalog_required.description: Whether to run the Public Contract Catalog gate. Default: true.

governance_checks.description: Named governance assertions to verify in repository content.

provider_authorization.description: Provider authorization state expected in this change. 'none' = no authorization granted. Changing to 'authorized' requires separate human-approved governance phase.

endpoint_approval.description: Endpoint approval state. 'none' = endpoints not approved. Approval requires separate governance phase.

external_io.description: External IO boundary. 'prohibited' = no external IO enabled. Default: prohibited.

real_provider.description: Real provider state. 'prohibited' = no real provider usage. Default: prohibited.

automatic_publishing.description: Automatic SNS publishing state. 'prohibited' = not enabled. Default: prohibited.

force_push.description: Force push policy. 'prohibited' = force push disabled. Cannot be overridden.

example_governance_docs.description: Example manifest for a versionless governance documentation commit
